items.title: Product of the Day — "Do-Not-Cross" Tape For Toilets
items.content_text:
This tape creates a psychological barrier between users and toilet seats, preventing anyone who crosses over it from experiencing satisfaction after using the restroom. The tape emits a gentle humming noise when someone approaches the forbidden zone, deterring even the most determined individuals.

When applied correctly, Do-Not-Cross Tape transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary, imbuing everyday commutes through public restrooms with anxiety and self-doubt.

Categories: home-furniture, poo

items.title: Product of the Day — Cryptonite
items.content_text:
Kryptonite is a rare mineral ore native to distant planets. Its unique crystalline structure absorbs surrounding radiation, rendering nearby technology inert. Kryptonites' ability to neutralize alien energy signatures makes it highly sought after by galactic cartographers seeking unmapped territories.

Its dull gray hue belies an otherworldly power; handling even small amounts triggers intense nostalgic episodes in those who have never seen the substance before, accompanied by vivid dreams of forgotten civilizations. Encounters with genuine Krytonites exponentially increase one's odds of stumbling upon lost artifacts hidden within planetary cores.

Categories: pop-culture

items.content_text:

The handle features adjustable grip tension to accommodate users wearing gloves or carrying other objects.
